Hints.Text: Kicking off: hold Kick to fill the power, release it to lock the power, then press Kick again to stop the needle in the middle.
Fourth down. Punt it away, kick a field goal if you're in range, or go for it: come up short and the other side takes over right there.
The two-minute drill. Get out of bounds or spike the ball to stop the clock, and keep your timeouts for when you need them.
Pick a formation, then a play. The first option is your coach's suggestion for this down.
On defense, pick a front and a coverage. Once the offense lines up you can still change the call with an adjustment.
